newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya bandits kill 57, including police.
newsitem.headline: Kenya bandits kill 57, including police.

text.p: Bandits raided a remote Kenyan village last Sunday and gunned down 57 people, including 16 policemen rushed in to tackle them, a police statement said on Saturday.

The statement faxed to Reuters said seven more people were hospitalised after the attack in a village in the northeastern Marsabit district while 21 others were treated for minor wounds and discharged.
The statement said the raiders, believed to be Ethiopians, also stole thousands of cattle, donkeys and goats.
"Bodies of the 16 police officers were found on Friday March 28. During the raid on Sunday March 23, 41 civilians were also killed by the invaders," the statement said.

Cross-border raids, mainly for livestock, are common on Kenya's land borders with neighbouring Ethiopia, Sudan, Tanzania and Uganda but last Sunday's incident was the highest death toll in recent times, police officers said.
